question_text:
2.  
Total Assets & Current liabilities of the Manju Limited are 50 lakhs & 10 
lakhs respectively. ROCE is 15%, measure of business operating risk is at 
3.5 & P/V ratio is 70%. Calculate Sales.  
(a)  
21 lakhs 
(b)  
30 lakhs 
(c)  
37.50 lakhs 
(d)  
40 lakhs 

 
FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT AND 
STRATEGIC MANAGEMENT 
 
 
77 
 
SEPTEMBER 2026 EXAMINATION 
REVISION TEST PAPERS
suggested_answer: (B) ROCE = EBIT / Total Capital Employed Total Capital Employed = Total Assets – Current Liabilities = 50 lakhs – 10 lakhs = 40 lakhs EBIT = 40 lakhs x 15% = 6 lakhs Now, OL of 3.5 = Contribution / EBIT Therefore Contribution = 6 Lakhs X 3.5 = 21 lakhs Sales = Contribution/PV Ratio=21 lakhs/0.7=30 lakhs
